gloss: sake lees pickle; pickled in sake lees

definitions.gloss: sake lees pickle; pickled in sake lees
definitions.explanation: food preserved in sake kasu (the solid residue from sake brewing)

examples.japanese: {粕漬|かすづ}けの{魚|さかな}を{焼|や}いた。
examples.english: I grilled fish pickled in sake lees.

examples.japanese: {粕漬|かすづ}けは{風味|ふうみ}が{良|よ}い。
examples.english: Sake lees pickles have a nice flavor.

examples.japanese: {大根|だいこん}の{粕漬|かすづ}けを{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I bought some daikon pickled in sake lees.

notes:
ABOUT SAKE KASU:
{酒粕|さけかす} is the solid residue left after pressing sake. It has a mild alcoholic content and a distinctive sweet, fermented flavor.

COMMON ITEMS:
- {魚|さかな}の{粕漬|かすづ}け (fish pickled in sake lees - often grilled)
- {野菜|やさい}の{粕漬|かすづ}け (vegetables in sake lees)
- {奈良漬|ならづ}け (a famous type of vegetable kasuzuke)

FLAVOR:
{粕漬|かすづ}け has a distinctive sweet and savory flavor with subtle alcoholic notes. Fish prepared this way is often called {西京漬|さいきょうづ}け when made with white miso and sake lees.

RELATED:
- {酒粕|さけかす} (sake lees)
- {酢漬|すづ}け (vinegar pickle)
- {味噌漬|みそづ}け (miso pickle)
